verdict.rationale: ReadMe documents a public API reference for controlling docs programmatically (readme-docs-87), with export via the API and a separate Developer Metrics API (readme-docs-38, readme-docs-92). The official rdme CLI (readme-probe-3) points to a scriptable programmatic surface, though the evidence does not say the CLI is built on the API. Missing for 10: detail on endpoint coverage (which product operations are API-driveable), authentication and API-key docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.
